description: Issue a free canlicapital.com validation key (POST /api/v1/keys) and hold it in memory for this session. Only needed before a validation when neither CANLI_KEY nor local mode is set; the read tools (get_receipt, service_status, company_financial_history) never need a key. Quotas: 1000 validations per key per UTC day, 5 keys per client per UTC day, 1048576 bytes per validation request, 1024 bytes per key revocation request, 20000 observations per series, 200 variants per matrix.
name: get_key
title: Get a free validation key
